source_operations.before: In single shooting, the decision variables are the original-cell controls; set $X_{0,0}=x_0$ and recursively compute $X_{j+1,0}=\Phi_j(X_{j,0},u_j)$. In multiple shooting, the decision variables are node states and controls; fix $X_{0,0}=x_0$ and define defects $d_j=X_{j+1,0}-\Phi_j(X_{j,0},u_j)$. In collocation mode, use the same node/control variables and solved internal stage states; the collocation equations are solved internally by the implicit-stage procedure above. Explicit stages are likewise internal deterministic evaluations. After every interval map in every mode, check $\Phi_j\in\Omega_x$ before using it as a later start or evaluating a path constraint, terminal cost, or endpoint constraint; otherwise return `stage-domain-failure` with no objective candidate. If $U_c$ is available only as a compact set-membership constraint and has no finite smooth representation, return the finite set-constrained model with `nlp_status=not-smooth-nlp`; the dispatcher must not treat it as an SQP-ready NLP. A QP solver route additionally requires the sampled control constraints to be affine.

source_operations.before: Definition: Definition checks a nonempty strict mesh and all stage/constraint times in [0,T] before evaluation; zero caps and tolerances retain initial residual checks or budget failure. One-cell and one-stage transcriptions are allowed. Singular linear stage matrices, inadmissible seeds, unavailable derivatives and exhausted node caps have explicit failure statuses. Empty declared path-constraint sets add no nodes or residuals. The mesh is rechecked after path-node insertion; original decision nodes, stage inputs, and every interval endpoint are checked against the smooth-data state domain. The direct linear stage branch requires a supplied exact pointwise A,B representation, and pointwise control sampling at nodes is specified. Refined-mesh stage times, multiple-shooting start states, every stage input, and every interval endpoint are checked before their downstream evaluations; the exact linear stage branch requires the supplied pointwise $A,B$ representation.
